svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: AI Receptionist: Voice agent that books, waitlists and escalates via LLM tool-calling.; Intervexa: Mock interviews that adapt to every answer, in 8 languages.; FixMyResume: Scores resumes against a JD: +35% ATS match in under 5s.; DataStory AI: CSV in, a narrated data story out.; WriteFlow: Full publishing platform on serverless Postgres.; YT2Notes: YouTube videos into AI study notes.

g.text: A real-time voice agent that books appointments, runs waitlists
and hands off to humans via LLM tool-calling. A SaaS for 12
business verticals, with PII encryption and row-level security.
Mock interviews that adapt to every answer,
Scores resumes against a JD: +35% ATS
CSV in, a narrated data story out.
YouTube videos into AI study notes.
